_about: Loot containers as the raid planner sees them, one per map marker type. Researched 2026-11-08 from the wiki's container pages (Containers rev 43934) and MetaForge's map legend; weights are this app's estimate, since no source publishes drop rates. `pool` tags are loot areas (medical, arc, ...), `cat:<item category>`, or `*` (anything that spawns in loot areas). `items` are named in the container's own loot table and score highest. Husks, probes and couriers take their items from arc_loot.json. `loot: false` keeps a marker out of the loot model. `confidence`: confirmed (wiki states it), likely (one source, or the wiki flags it unconfirmed), unverified, or in-game (checked in game). Display names marked `check_name` still need an in-game look.

containers.name: Container
containers.notes: MetaForge's catch-all for ordinary containers (13,000+ markers: drawers, cabinets, crates, trash bins, terminals). What it holds follows the zone it's in.

containers.name: Locker
containers.notes: Wiki: Industrial loot type, red/green/blue variants; red lockers in residential zones roll residential loot. MetaForge also files medical drawers and cabinets here, so only about a fifth of these are real lockers.

containers.name: Backpack
containers.notes: Wiki: Raider loot; Quick Use items and Topside Materials. MetaForge calls these Bag.

containers.name: Suitcase
containers.notes: The wiki page has no loot table yet; the pool is the earlier estimate.

containers.name: Basket
containers.notes: Wicker Basket. Appears with Lush Blooms or Cold Snap; also in the Stella Montis cafeteria behind an unpowered door. Holds many Scrappy training items.

containers.name: Box
containers.notes: Only 8 markers, all on Blue Gate (Gate Box, Pole Box, Raider Camp Box). No wiki container matches.

containers.name: Car
containers.notes: The breachable Car Hood (Mechanical and Electrical loot); seats can be searched too. Some cars have an alarm trap.

containers.name: Grenade Tube
containers.notes: MetaForge's own legend labels this marker Grenade Tube (its key says utility_crate).

containers.name: Electrical Container
containers.notes: A legacy MetaForge category with one marker.

containers.name: Industrial Container
containers.notes: A legacy MetaForge category with one marker.

containers.name: Medical Bag
containers.notes: MetaForge calls these Med Crate. The wiki's table is flagged unconfirmed; on Stella Montis it adds the Osprey Blueprint.

containers.name: Ammo Case
containers.notes: MetaForge calls these Ammo Crate.

containers.name: Weapon Case
containers.notes: Weapons, attachments, gun parts and ammo matching its weapon. Guides say a weapon is always inside. MetaForge also files some weapon racks here.

containers.name: Combat Supplies
containers.notes: Raider supply clusters that spawn during Close Scrutiny (Dam, Blue Gate, Buried City, Spaceport). No wiki page.

containers.name: Raider Cache
containers.notes: Ammo, blueprints, grenades, healing, quick use, shields, weapons and attachments. Many more, with better loot, during Uncovered Caches; under Cold Snap they must be breached.

containers.name: Frozen Raider Cache
containers.notes: A Raider Cache frozen over; it must be breached. Pendola Pass.

containers.name: First Wave Cache
containers.notes: Only during Hurricane. Since 1.18.0 slightly fewer blueprints but better high-tier materials. MetaForge calls these Hurricane Cache.

containers.name: Breachable Container
containers.notes: MetaForge's catch-all for breachables: transformers, data servers, server racks, technology and metal crates, engine hoods.

containers.name: Security Locker
containers.notes: Only raiders with the Security Breach skill can open it. Weapons and components, rarely epic weapons and Complex Gun Parts. Since 1.7.0 they spawn dynamically, so these markers are candidate spots.

containers.name: Android
containers.notes: Pendola Pass and Stella Montis. The wiki flags the table unconfirmed.

containers.name: ARC Husk
containers.notes: A generic husk marker (5 on Blue Gate and Riven Tides) whose type MetaForge doesn't say.

containers.name: ARC Probe
containers.notes: Breaching it calls nearby ARC.

containers.name: Supply Station
containers.notes: Call in a Supply Drop here (ammo, quick use, weapons). The flare shows where it lands and draws other raiders. Not every station is active each raid.

containers.name: Field Crate
containers.notes: A crate you carry to a Field Depot; delivering it opens a reward with a choice of loot. Not a container to search.
